entries.head:
RAJYA SABHA
————
List of Questions for ORAL ANSWERS
to be asked at a sitting of the Rajya Sabha to be held on
Tuesday, the December 2, 2003 /Agrahayana 11, 1925 (Saka)
————
(Ministries:  Civil Aviation; Finance; Petroleum and Natural Gas; Tourism
and Culture; Water Resources)
Total number of questions—20
1
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Provision for CNG  in cities
†*1. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of PETROLEUM AND
NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) the cities in the country where
C.N.G. is proposed to be provided for the
plying of buses during the next year;
(b) whether the Ministry is considering
to open a C.N.G. filling station in Dehradun,
the capital of Uttaranchal; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Status of tourism industry
*2. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of TOURISM AND
CULTURE be pleased to state:
(a) the present status of tourism
industry of the country as compared to
those of prominent countries; and
(b) what is the expectation for the
current year and the steps taken to reach
the target of three million international
tourists for the country?
Profits of overseas branches of SBI
and IOB
*3. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there had
been drastic fall in the net profit of overseas
branches of State Bank of India and Indian
Overseas Bank during 2001-2002; if so, the
details thereof and the reasons therefor;
(b) what is the position of these banks
reflected during the year 2002-2003; and
(c) what steps have been taken to
improve the situation?
Pipeline for transportation of oil
†*4. SHRI KAPIL SIBAL:
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of PETROLEUM
AND NATURAL GAS be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that a project for
laying of pipelines for transportation of oil
has been prepared by certain public sector
oil companies and sent for Government's
approval;
(b) if so, the names of the companies by
which such proposals have been sent to
Government by October, 2003; and

2
(c) the rate at which the dividend is
expected to accrue on the capital invested
in these projects?
Foreign investment in several
sectors
*5. MISS MABEL REBELLO: Will the
Minister of FINANCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
propose to allow increased foreign
investment in insurance, telecom, aviation,
coffee and rubber plantations;
(b) whether it is also a fact that easier
norms have been drawn for foreign
investment in banks, small industries and
petroleum retailing; and
(c) if so, the details of Government policy
in this regard for the above sectors?
Linking of Mahanadi and Vaigal rivers
*6. SHRI K. RAMA MOHANA RAO:
Will the Minister of WATER RESOURCES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to take
up linking of Mahanadi with Vaigal rivers
early to tackle the problem of recurrent
floods and droughts in different parts of the
country;
(b) if so, by when the link-work would
start; and
(c) if not, in what manner water
requirements in Andhra Pradesh which are
to be taken up with a national perspective,
are proposed to be solved?
Fake currency notes
*7. DR. ABRAR AHMED:
DR. DASARI NARAYANA
RAO:
Will the Minister  of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have made
any assessment about the fake Indian
currency notes in circulation as on date;
(b) whether Government have reasons
to believe that Pakistan Government is
behind this fake Indian currency notes
circulation; and
(c) if so, the steps Government have
taken in this regard?
Trade to Trade deals in BSE
*8. SHRI SANJAY NIRUPAM: Will
the Minister of FINANCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether SEBI has banned Trade to
Trade deals in Bombay Stock Exchange;
and
(b) if so, the details of the companies
which have been banned and the reasons
therefor?
Fraud cases in banks
*9. DR. DASARI NARAYANA RAO:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether quite a good number of fraud
cases have come to light in banking sector
in which banks were defrauded substantial
amount of money;
(b) if so, the details of frauds detected in
each bank during the last three years,
year-wise and bank-wise;
(c) in how many cases, insiders were
involved, bank-wise; and
(d) the action taken by each bank,
year-wise?

3
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.
Interest rate on deposits
†*10. SHRI RAJIV RANJAN SINGH
'LALAN':
SHRI LAJPAT RAI:
Will the Minister of FINANCE be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that rate of interest
on deposits was reduced from time to time
by Public Sector Banks during the period
from March, 2000 to October, 2003;
(b) if so, the extent of reduction in the
rate of interest made by each of the Public
Sector Banks alongwith the dates on which
such reduction was made; and
(c) the rates of interest that were in force
for the various term deposits schemes in
these banks at the end of  April, 2000 and
October, 2003?
Right to contamination-free water to
domestic users
*11. SHRI MANOJ
BHATTACHARYA:
SHR

1
Open sky policy for ASEAN
countries
1. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION
be pleased to state:
(a) whether the Prime Minister's
announcement of a unilateral 'open-sky
policy' for the 10 member-countries
grouped under the ASEAN is to expedite
greater economic integration of the Indian
economy with one of the fastest growing
regions of the world;
(b) if so, whether under this declaration,
a number of countries like Singapore,
Thailand and Vietnam will be allowed to
operate daily flights to Delhi, Mumbai,
Kolkata and Chennai after entering into
bilateral air-services talks with India; and
(c) if so, to what extent this proposal
has been accepted and implemented?
New navigational system by AAI
2. SHRI RAMA MUNI REDDY
SIRIGIREDDY: Will the Minister of
CIVIL AVIATION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the Airports
Authority of India have any plan to
introduce satellite based navigational
system in place of old conventional ground-
based systems like radars;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) in what manner it will help in
increasing the flight operations; and
(d) in what manner it will help in
opening up possibilities of new air routes?
Maintenance of aircrafts
†3. SHRI JANESHWAR MISHRA:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the number
of airworthy planes is less than required;
(b) whether it is also a fact that the
arrangement for manufacturing and repairs
of such planes is inadequate; and
(c) if so, the details thereof?
Gender discrimination in AI
4. SHRI K. CHANDRAN PILLAI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that there are
disparities in norms and conditions
pertaining to the women crew vis-a-vis  the
men crew onboard Air India flights;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

standards on retirement age limit, medical
check ups, etc.;
(c) if so, whether it amounts to gender

(d) what is Government's response

Air service between Bhopal and
Jabalpur
5. SHRI P. K.  MAHESHW ARI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government have any
proposal to start Indian Airlines service
between Bhopal and Jabalpur;
(b) if so, by when; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Enhancement of air services
6. SHRI P. K.  MAHESHW ARI: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether Government propose to
increase the frequency of flights to Bhopal;
(b) if so, by when additional flights are
likely to resume; and
(c) if not, the reasons therefor?
Air service from Vijayawada
airport
7. DR. DASARI NARA YANA RAO:
Will the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether air traffic to and fro
Vijayawada airport in Andhra Pradesh has
commenced;
(b) if so, the details thereof;
(c) the details of air companies which
are operating their flights from the said
airport; and
(d) what steps Government have taken
to make this airport airworthy for big
aircrafts?
Impact of Open Sky policy on
AI and IA
8. DR. ALLADI P. RAJKUMAR: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether the 'Open Sky' policy for
ASEAN is likely to hit the earnings of Air
India and Indian Airlines; and
(b) if so, the measures taken to prevent
any adverse impact on the revenue of
Airlines?
Development of runway at Haridwar
†9. SHRI HARISH RAWAT: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether BHEL controlled run way
at Haridwar is proposed to be developed
as a regular runway;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) if not, the details of the steps being
taken to provide proper air service to the
city in view of its international importance
as a religious city?
Privatisation of Mumbai and Delhi
airports
10. SHRI RAJKUMAR DHOOT: Will
the Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be
pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
have decided to privatise Delhi and Mumbai
Airports;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

3
(b) if so, the details thereof including
FDI and foreign partners; and
(c) what precautions have been taken
to ensure national interest in traffic control
and civil aviation security?
IA's joint venture with Singapore
Airlines for ground handling
11. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of CIVIL AVIATION be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Indian
Airlines has decided to tie up with
Singapore Airlines to handle the ground
handling business;
(b) if so, the details thereof; and
(c) whether it is a fact that the Indian
Airlines did not consider the offer from
foreign airlines and their subs
